title: Plan ahead with Pouch, spend and earn with Lifestyle
summary: Pouch and Lifestyle are now in Grey, with new ways to organise your money, handle everyday expenses, and earn rewards from your Grey virtual card.
body_markdown:
Money can mean different things. It might be your next flight, this month’s bills, an emergency fund, or something you’ve been saving toward for months.


Until now, Grey has been the place your money passes through. Now, you can do more with it while it’s here, with Pouch and Lifestyle.


Lifestyle brings everyday services and rewards into one place, while Pouch gives you a simple way to split your balance and organise your money around your plans. Together, they give you more to do with your Grey balance, from spending and earning rewards to preparing for what’s next.


## More ways to spend and earn with Lifestyle


[Lifestyle](http://grey.co/lifestyle) brings everyday digital services and rewards together in the Grey app.


Instead of only using Grey to receive, send, and spend money, you can now use your balance for more of the things you need day to day. From the Lifestyle tab, you can get eSIMs and, where available, buy airtime and data or pay supported bills.


Your spending can also earn you rewards. Eligible Grey card payments earn points you can track directly in Lifestyle and redeem for available rewards.


So, the next time you need data for your phone, an eSIM for a trip, or want to check the rewards you’ve earned from using your Grey card, you can find it all in Lifestyle.


Services vary by location, so check the Lifestyle tab in your Grey app to see what’s available to you.


## Give every goal its own Pouch


Maybe you’re planning your next adventure, building an emergency fund, buying something special, or preparing for future investments.


[Create different Pouches](http://grey.co/pouch) for the things that matter to you, give each one a name, and choose how much you want to keep aside. Having separate spaces for different goals makes it easier to see what you’re working on and stay connected to your plans.


Instead of looking at one balance and trying to remember what you can and can’t spend, you can split your balance and give each amount a purpose. And because plans change, your money isn’t locked away. You can move it back to your Grey balance when you need it.


## Hold funds in dollars, pounds and euros


For people who earn, spend, or move money across currencies, you can also decide what works best for you. If you receive money in USD, EUR, or GBP, you can create a Pouch in that same currency without converting first.


Use your USD for your next adventure, your EUR for a big purchase, or keep your GBP ready for something important you’re planning.


## Put Round-ups on autopilot


Sometimes the easiest way to reach a goal is to make it part of something you already do.


With Round-ups, the spare change from eligible Grey card payments can automatically go into a Pouch you choose. Every time you use your Grey card, you can put a little extra aside for your goal.


For example, if you spend $8.60 on your Grey card, your payment is rounded up to $9, and the remaining $0.40 goes into your Pouch.


Small amounts, collected over time, can help you keep moving closer to the things you want.


## Everything you need, in one place


Grey already helps you receive, hold, send, and spend money across currencies. Now, Pouch and Lifestyle give you even more ways to use and manage your money without needing a separate app.


So whether you’re keeping money ready for what’s next, getting connected in a new city, paying a bill back home, or picking up something you need, you can do more of it without leaving Grey.


Your money can stay where it is, while more of your life happens around it.


[Open your Grey app](http://onelink.to/grey) to explore Lifestyle and create your first Pouch today.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### What is Pouch?


Pouch is a Grey feature that helps you set aside money for specific goals. You can create separate Pouches for your plans, choose your preferred currency, and track your progress in one place.


### Which currencies can I use for Pouch?


You can create Pouches in USD, EUR, and GBP.


### Can I create more than one Pouch?


Yes. You can create multiple Pouches for different goals, such as travel, an emergency fund, a big purchase, or future plans.


### Does Pouch earn interest?


Not yet. Pouch currently holds your funds separately and does not earn interest.


### What are Round-ups?


Round-ups automatically move the spare change from eligible Grey card payments into a Pouch you choose. It’s a simple way to make progress as you spend.


### Do I need a new Grey account to use Pouch?


No. Pouch is already part of the Grey app, so you can use it with your existing account.


### Can I keep money without converting my currency?


Yes. With Pouch, you can hold funds in USD, EUR, or GBP, so you can set aside money in the currency you already hold.


### Can I take money out of a Pouch whenever I want?


Yes, you can.


### What is Lifestyle on Grey?


Lifestyle is a space in the Grey app where you can access everyday services and rewards. Depending on availability in your location, you can get eSIMs, buy airtime and data, pay supported bills, and access rewards.


### How do Grey points work?


You can earn points on eligible Grey card payments. You can view your points balance in Lifestyle and redeem them for available rewards.


### Is Lifestyle available everywhere?


Availability varies by service and location. Open the Lifestyle tab in your Grey app to see the services currently available to you.
